task: E19: MiniMax-H3 (33.1B) under the E8 protocol -- the size axis, plus a new text encoder (Qwen3-VL-32B) and a new VAE layout (24ch, f16t4d24)

transformer.note: dense single-stream Omni Transformer; text/audio/video share one sequence

text_encoder.note: downloaded; NOT used for E19 -- the probe conditions on a single dummy text row, as all backbones do

raw_checkpoint_also_on_disk.why: the original checkpoint. Its transformer keys are `blocks.*` / `final_layer.*` and diffusers cannot load it, so `transformer/` (diffusers format) is what E19 uses. Kept because the FL2VA video_vae wrapper is the fallback loader in e19_extract.py.

relative_depth_cell.why: 16/30 of the stack, E8's convention, on 50 layers

frame_geometry.why_not_49: 49 is not encodable: the VAE accepts 17*n+5 frames only, and 49 would snap to 56 (17 latents), changing temporal resolution relative to E8. 39 gives 12 latents, matching the 13 the other backbones get.

design.pixel_convention: ImageNet-normalised RGB over [0,1], NOT Wan's [-1,1]. The extractor converts; `raw_pixel_32` still uses [-1,1] because the pixel arm is recomputed in the analysis on H3's own 17/17/5 binning.
design.vae_posterior: sampled under a fixed generator (seed 42), then fp16-rounded - the released recipe

probe.implementation: imported from e12_analyse.probe_oof / auc_of and e8_verdict.interpretable -- never re-implemented (E11 lesson)

system_python_versions.why_recorded: E8-E18 ran here; the two sets of versions are incompatible by design

peak_vram_gb.note: one process per GPU; two would OOM

download.why: single-stream throughput to HF's Xet CDN through the proxy was 65 KB/s (120 GB would take ~3 weeks). Measured scaling: 8 streams 0.7 MB/s, 32 -> 2.7, 96 -> 5.5-6.3. Chunked range requests with resume.
